The standard IS 7461 on General pIan of boundary dimensions for tapered roller bearings was first published in 1974 and was revised in 1980 to align with IS0 355 :" 1977 `Rolling bearings dimensions and series designation' in regard to the Metric tapered roller bearings - Boundary international practice followed fcr the designation of tapered roller bearings. tapered roller bearing - Double Subsequently Addendum 1 to IS0 355 : 1977 `Metric dimensions' and Addendum 2 to IS0 355 : 1977 `Metric tapered bearings - Boundary dimensicns' were issued in 1980. The subjects of cups - Boundary bearings - Flanged amendments were not covered in the Indian Standard. Therefore, the revision of IS 7461 has been taken up and follcwing three standards has been brought out to cover the subject given in IS0 355 : 1977, Addendum 1 to IS0 355 : 1977 and Addendum 2 to IS0 1977. 1) 2) 3) IS 7461 (Part 1 bearings: Part IS 7461 ( Part 2 bearings: Part IS ) 1 ) 2 : 1990 -General plan Single row bearings : 1990 General plan Double row bearings General cups plan of of of boundary boundary boundary dimensions dimensions dimensions for for for tapered tapered tapered row roller these : 1980 entire 355 : roller roller roller

The use of the Standard Mark is governed by the provisions of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 1986 and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The Standard Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard conveys rbe assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements of that standard under a well defined system of inspection, testing and quality control which is devised and supervised by BIS and operated by the producer. Standard marked products are also continuously checked by Details of conditions under BES for conformity to that standard as a further safeguard. which a licence for the use of the Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards.
